programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang directs this fascinating comedy about three couples and forbidden love across Macau and Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Kuo Tsing's (Alexander Fu Sheng) adventures continue in Part 3 of this series of film adaptations of 'The Eagle Shooting Heroes'.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: The famed Ivy Ling Po plays a mysterious swordswoman, who teams up with the Roving Knight in a battle against a string of intimidating villains.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung woos a famous courtesan, indulges in some gambling and helps out earthquake victims while incognito in Suzhou.

programme.title: Clan of the White Lotus
programme.desc: A hero (Gordon Liu Chia hui) must learn 'Embroidery Fist' and acupuncture to counter a villain's (Lo Lieh) deadly fight techniques.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: In this twisted comedy, a gambling game between a rookie con artist and an experienced flimflam man has life or death repercussions.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Chiang Li Ping plays a scorned wife, while Elaine Chin Yen Ling is the mistress who teaches the hypocritical husband that what goes around, comes around.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Daring Sung Dynasty must fight their way out of trap after trap and band together to save the prime minister.

programme.title: Men From the Monastery

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Three sisters (the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei) attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: In Part 2 of this adventure, only the title weapons' union can save the 6 remaining sects which vie for mastery of the martial world.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: This heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers tells the tale of a beautiful shepherdess, whose own problems drag her into a love triangle.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Hsuan sets out to apprehend George Eaton, a high profile thug who has escaped to Hong Kong. With home support, can Yang take him down?

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: Dubbed Little Bastard due to never having known his parents, a young man seeks his roots, with help from a staunch ally called Little Beggar.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: A secret service agent, Chao Pu Fun, must protect the innocent against a power-mad Eunuch.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: The Emperor develops a more deadly Flying Guillotine and trains a squad of women to combat the 'Iron Umbrella' and a band of rebels.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Kung fu idols Wang Yu, Lo Meng and Loh Lieh star in this comedy set in a Shaolin temple where Hung Hsi-kuan and Fang Shih-yu become disciples.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin loyalists (led by Alexander Fu Sheng and Chen Kuan Tai) go up against a formidable Manchu general and his Tibetan allies.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This comedy contains dramatisations of some of the funniest and most surreal film gossips of director Li Han-Hsiang's 30 year career.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: Wang Yu heads this film's stellar cast under martial arts master, Chang Cheh. Together, they present beautifully choreographed action scenes.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu gets out of jail, he gets involved again with his crooked Uncle Chou and caught in other rackets and silly situations.

programme.title: Forever and Ever
programme.desc: Huangmei Opera queen, Ivy Ling Po stars in this tale of a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter a girl who is dying.

programme.title: Les Belles

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung

programme.title: King Gambler

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A trio of heroes go up against a power-hungry Ming Dynasty official and also cross paths with three beauties.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy

programme.title: Enjoy Your Stay S1 Ep7
programme.desc: Kehilangan Tuan Rudi sudah menjadi buah mulut pekerja Damai Beach Resort. Tiba-tiba pekerja am Sean dan Beber diangkat menjadi pengurus segera kerana mereka yang paling lama berkhidmat di Damai Beach Resort selain Kak Maggie yang sudah amnesia. Sean dan Beber mempunyai dua sikap yang berbeza namun mereka perlu bersama-sama menjadi pengurus hotel untuk menyelamatkan hotel tersebut sementara menunggu kepulangan Tuan Rudi dan mendapatkan gaji mereka yang tertunggak. Kak Maggie seorang wanita cina yang buat kerja seperti sloth tetapi tahu tentang semua kedudukan kewangan hotel. Tuan Rudi pula telah melarikan diri kerana dia dikejar oleh Ah Long kerana tidak mampu membayar hutang.

programme.title: Saatchi S1 Ep8
programme.desc: Kavya, seorang gadis autistik dengan daya ingatan visual yang luar biasa, menjadi saksi kepada pembunuhan Datin Radha dari tingkap biliknya. Walaupun tidak mampu berkomunikasi secara tradisional, Kavya menggunakan lukisannya untuk mendedahkan apa yang berlaku pada malam kejadian. Dengan bantuan Karthik, seorang peguam muda yang bersikap empati tetapi bergelut dengan masalah keluarganya, Kavya berusaha membongkar misteri di sebalik pembunuhan itu.

programme.title: Catching Shadow S1 Ep13
programme.desc: Drama yang mengisahkan bagaimana Wen En, seorang jurutera keselamatan rangkaian di Ling Dun Network Security dibuang kerja dan memulakan syarikat keselamatannya sendiri.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Cyprus S1 Ep18
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang seorang lelaki bernama Yusuf, yang terperangkap dalam konflik yang semakin memuncak antara masyarakat Turki dan Yunani di Cyprus. Ketika ketegangan politik semakin meruncing, Yusuf bersama sahabat-sahabatnya harus membuat pilihan yang sukar antara mempertahankan bangsa dan mencari jalan damai. "Once Upon A Time In Cyprus" bukan hanya menceritakan tentang konflik, tetapi juga tentang kekuatan hubungan manusia, cinta dan pengorbanan dalam menghadapi cabaran yang tidak terduga.

programme.title: Pak Pandir Moden S1 Ep7
programme.desc: Kisah Pak Pandir, seorang lelaki lurus yang mengalami pelbagai masalah akibat dari sifat lurus bendulnya.

programme.title: Berita Mandarin
programme.desc: Ikuti berita berbahasa Mandarin yang memaparkan perkembangan politik, sosial, ekonomi, sukan, hiburan dan isu-isu semasa.

programme.title: Flying High S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Rancangan ini mengisahkan impian seseorang yang ingin bekerja dalam kerjaya yang diminati dapat direalisasikan. Tetapi hanya seorang peserta yang akan dipilih bagi setiap episod dan mereka akan menjalani beberapa ujian sebelum dipilih terima bekerja. Tiga ujian tersebut adalah perubahan imej, sesi latihan bimbingan bersama mentor terpilih dan terakhir adalah ujian.

programme.title: BERITA TAMIL
programme.desc: Berita berbahasa Tamil yang memaparkan perkembangan politik, sosial, ekonomi, sukan, hiburan dan isu-isu semasa.

programme.title: Gadis Kopi S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Ain kemalangan bersama bapanya Saidin ketika dalam perjalanan menghantar bekalan Kopi Wong di Kota Kinabalu. Ain selamat tapi Saidin dan pemandu van, Marius mati. Sejak tragedi itu, Tauke Wong mengambil Ain sebagai anak angkat. Wong membesarkan Ain seperti anaknya sendiri. Diberi pendidikan agama dan akademik. Ain disayangi oleh keluarga Wong.

programme.title: Jersey

programme.title: Acting Out of Love
programme.desc: Hung Jen, struggling actor meets Hui Hsin, an associate producer who must write a script for a love story. He invites her out on a date as a research for her script and soon falls in love.

programme.title: Mission Milano
programme.desc: Andy Lau & Huang Xiao Ming embark on a cross-border quest in the quest to protect an incredible new invention from an international crime conglomerate.

programme.title: Life Hotel

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: Ip Man fights some gangsters to protect a school, and is challenged by a Wing Chun master. He accepts the duel for his family and disciples and emerges victorious, securing the Grandmaster title.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths.

programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, once a golden boy, sees his glory fade after the birth of Xu Qi An. Yet, rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: While vacationing in Thailand, a group of teen friends summons up troublesome spirits using the 10 methods outlined in a mysterious book.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: Mei Jing leads the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit to infiltrate the drug cartel in Dong Zhou area, but they were ambushed and her father's identity as an undercover is exposed.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: Sing is back, only this time he doesn't go back to school. Instead, Sing goes undercover as the husband of a wealthy socialite.

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behavior and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. When he meets his teenage nephew who is ashamed of his stutter, the two develop a special friendship through mutual understanding.

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon: The One Billion Insp
programme.desc: Hong Kong is facing a rise in corruption & rookie cop Xu Le is demoted when he offends an inspector. It is when Xu Le changes his belief that he eventually becomes a legendary detective.

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, once a golden boy, sees his glory fade after the birth of Xu Qi An. Yet, rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: I Love Hong Kong
programme.desc: Ng Shun and his family return to the estate where he grew up after his business has failed. When his family squeeze into the small flat, Ng Shun is forced to face his long-neglected family problems...

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a case where the body was undiscovered for 8 years. During the investigation, the prosecutor finds all inconsistencies & suspicions fall on Choi.

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: A failed drug raid leaves an undercover cop trapped and a drug lord vowing to seek revenge. Senior Police Inspector Li resorts to blackmailing a drug dealer with his daughter to arrest the drug lord.

programme.title: The Calling of a Bus Driver
programme.desc: Based on a true story, a girl named Suki aspire to fulfill her dream after leaving with her cheating boyfriend. Later, when invited to attend his wedding, she schemes to have her revenge.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling, who dreams of becoming a secret agent, accidentally rescues an injured spy. He agrees to make her his apprentice, turning her upside down as she goes on madcap adventures.

programme.title: Wu Xia
programme.desc: To protect his family, a martial artist hides his identity living in a remote village with his wife & two sons. He gets embroiled in a bizarre murder case & is forced into a death duel.

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: Adapted from a novel of the same name by Erica Li, an urban sketcher suffering from ALS asks his crush to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day.

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: A pregnant woman gains the ability to see ghosts after her attempted suicide. She comes to suspect that it is related to the female ghost she witnessed jumping into the path of an oncoming train.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: First instalment of the new remake of The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, adapted from Jin Yong's novel, see Zhang Wu Ji embroiled in a dispute involving two legendary weapons.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles?

programme.title: S Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk must work with Inspector Lau to bring down a crime syndicate involved in illegal soccer betting. Though they did not start things well, they managed to complete the task together.

programme.title: Everything is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming must attend his father's funeral to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and her family, but ended up falling into their trap.

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street
programme.desc: A Pakistani refugee receive help from a taxi driver after his father died in a car crash. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the truth behind his father's death.

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: Hong Kong's survival is at risk due to a radiation leak. A fire brigade is assigned to stop cesium fallout by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented disaster, can they save the city?

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over her young son's death by becoming a foster parent. Her dedication to the children leads her to neglect her husband. Will the couple be able to salvage their relationship?

programme.title: Shock Wave 2
programme.desc: A series of bomb threats is causing fear in Hong Kong. An ex-bomb disposal officer becomes prime suspect after a terrorist attack & becomes a fugitive to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Ha Ha Ha Happy New Year!!
programme.desc: Business tycoon Duan accidentally loses his memory. As he is cared for by a temple owner, Duan discovers that he has been replaced by a doppelganger, prompting him to uncover a shocking hidden secret.

programme.title: Ah Boys to Men 2
programme.desc: Ken and his band of brothers return to serve the nation again, with Ken determined to change & prove himself a better man. However, his mates feel otherwise, causing tension among them.

programme.title: Echoes of the Thunder
programme.desc: Nam and Fire are top racing drivers. Nam is depressed after causing a young racing driver's injury. Fire decides to compete in an illegal street car race to stand up for Nam. Can he succeed finally?

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: Hao Ren inherits the skills of Locksmith Shan and befriends Detective Liu who often seeks his help. When Hao Ren unveils the mystery of Shan's wife's disappearance one day, strange events ensue.

programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: Donnie Yen, Chow Yun Fat & Aaron Kwok star in this classic-inspired tale of the Monkey King's legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Protege
programme.desc: Undercover agent Nick finds himself in a moral dilemma when the time to betray his mentor finally came. Starring Andy Lau, Louis Koo, Daniel Wu and more!

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards & featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty.

programme.title: I Fine..Thank You..Love You
programme.desc: In this high grossing Thai romcom starring Sunny who portrays Yim. In order to win back his Japanese girlfriend, Yim hires a charming tutor to improve his English but falls for her instead.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A triad boss aims to clean up his image and win Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change, but struggles with funding issues. As his enforcers resort to violence, unexpected tensions arise among them.

programme.title: Where the Wind Blows
programme.desc: Two notorious corrupt police officers, Detectives Lui Lok and Nam Kong were found to build a corruption network between the triad and police, the ICAC begins to hunt them down to end their control.

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, once a golden boy, sees his glory fade after the birth of Xu Qi An. Yet, rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: There Is No Escape From Fate
programme.desc: An innocent Hong Kong businessman is wrongfully imprisoned in a brutal multinational prison, and must escape the sadistic warden's torture to survive.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Kung Fu Dunk
programme.desc: Two talented basketball players, one seeking his parents and the other, a depressed alcoholic, are forced to compromise for the sake of the game. Starring Jay Chou, Eric Tsang, Ng Man Tat & more.

programme.title: CZ12
programme.desc: Jackie Chan stars as the Asian Hawk, a top agent sent to retrieve the bronze heads of twelve animals of the Chinese Zodiac, stolen in Beijing in 1860.

programme.title: Customs Frontline

programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career, but Adam is determined to win her back and makes 77 attempts to do so. The situation worsens when a Thai movie idol courts Eva.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth 2
programme.desc: Set as a prequel, when the sun was found to be dying, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home. To save the world, a group of young people decide to step forth.

programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.desc: Two brothers, Yun and Fei, face challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, and Fei and his girlfriend opt for a 'marriage cooling-off period' to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg

programme.desc: A retired spy Ling Ling Chat, now a meat vendor is brought in to investigate a case after a giant dinosaur skull is stolen.

Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: May We Chat
programme.desc: Yan, Wei Wei and Yi Ji are three troubled young women from very different backgrounds who met on We Chat, a social media platform, and will do anything to escape each of their troubled lives. When Yan suddenly disappears one day, Wei Wei and Yi Ji start to track her whereabouts, only to find out shocking truths about her that were never revealed.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has posttraumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Gambler
programme.desc: Manfred and Flora are gambling addicts who have come across each other a few times at the casino, but do not leave impression on each other until they both suffer heavy losses and are held hostage by the loan sharks in Macau. They find themselves falling in love, and decide to get married when they come back to Hong Kong.

programme.title: Acting Out of Love
programme.desc: Wei Hung Jen is a struggling actor who gets fired but finds a job behind the scene. Hui Hsin, the associate producer, must write a script for a love story so as to get a reference letter to study scriptwriting overseas. As Jen falls for Hui, he invites her out on a date as a research for her script and they start acting out of love.

programme.title: Mission Milano
programme.desc: A wealthy entrepreneur goes undercover with an Interpol agent to protect a new invention, the Seed of God, from falling into an international crime conglomerate.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his father's heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title.

programme.title: Detective vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths". Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real Chosen Sleuth instead of a lunatic.

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat stars as a down-on-his-luck gambler, Water, whose ex-girlfriend asked him to take care of their autistic son. As Water lives with his son, he soon finds his goal in life. When he discovers his son's talent in running, Water decides to give up his dissipated life and support his son to achieve his dream.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: The millionaire, Million Wong , is found dead in a hotel room. Officer Sing Sing (Stephen Chow) is called in when a man is murdered with an ice pick during sexual intercourse. By an uncanny coincidence the man looks identical to Sing so the decision is made to send him in as an undercover again for further investigation. In the same day, he finds himself with a beautiful wife (Anita Mui), an incompetent sidekick (Anthony Wong) and one very unhappy girlfriend (Cheung Man). All this and somehow he still has to try and solve the case!

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wang's only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: Chasing the Dragon (2020)
programme.desc: In 1960s Hong Kong, rookie cop Xu Le cracks a robbery but gets demoted instead, as this offends a corrupt inspector. Xu meets a rich girl Bai who falls instantly in love with him one day. Will he break up with his childhood girlfriend for Bai so as to climb the social ladder, and how does Xu eventually become one of Hong Kong's legendary detective?

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: I Love Hong Kong
programme.desc: Ng Shun and his family return to the public housing estate where he grew up, not to visit his aging father, but to seek refuge after his business has failed. When his family of five squeeze into the small estate unit, Ng Shun is forced to face his long-neglected family problems...

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a death scene investigation where the deceased body had laid undiscovered for eight years. A prosecutor joins the investigation after Choi has identified the suspect, and finds Choi's actions suspicious when all manner of inconsistencies come to light from his statement...

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yang's rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun!

programme.title: The Calling Of A Bus Driver
programme.desc: A girl named Suki fulfills her dream of being a bus driver after breaking up with her boyfriend, who has an affair with her good friend. When Suki is invited to attend her ex-boyfriend's wedding, she is presented with a chance for revenge - will she take it and turn her life around?

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Wu Xia
programme.desc: Martial artist Liu hides his identity and lives in a remote village with his wife Ah Yu and their two sons, but somehow gets embroiled in a bizarre murder case. Constable Xu is a kung fu fanatic, whose curiosity forces Liu into a death duel with the Sect Leader of the 72 Demons, and puts Liu's family and homeland in a great danger...

programme.title: Bujang Berani S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Wira 1 Renjer - Negara kita pernah mengalami zaman peperangan muncul perwira yang menggadaikan nyawa untuk menjaga kedaulatan negara. Merekalah merupaka wira yang jasa mereka harus dikenang. Bujang berani menjejaki kisah pahlawan patriotik Sarawak yang digelar Bujang Berani. Dalam episod kali ini bujang berani akan menjejaki kisah Wira 1 Renjer.

programme.title: Ayam Goreng Abah
programme.desc: Farhan terpaksa akur berhenti kerja kerana tiada sesiapa yang boleh menjaga abahnya yang jatuh sakit. Jamil pula sangat pemarah. Salah sikit mula menempik. Asyik bergaduh dua beranak itu. Sama-sama panas hati. Pak Kasim dan Lily, jiran sebelah rumah Farhan yang banyak membantu berikan sokongan moral dan fizikal kepada Farhan. Irin tidak boleh terima keputusan Farhan berhenti kerja dan jaga abahnya. Hari-hari Pak Jamil nak makan ayam goreng. Tak nak lauk lain dah. Buntu juga Farhan terutama bila ayam habis.

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V2
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Tanya Hassan S1 Ep11
programme.desc: Mencium Dahi Jenazah - Episod kali ini Ustaz menjawab soalan dan membincangkan mengenai adakah mencium dahi jenazah adalah satu sunnah? Ustaz Hassan menjawab pertanyaan itu dan menerangkan bahawa itu adalah salah satu daripada sunnah nabi. Beliau juga menyatakan bahawa hanya mahram sahaja yang boleh mencium dahi jenazah dan beberapa penerangan lebih mendalam dibincangkan dalam topik ini.

programme.title: Religious Clip S69 Ep18
programme.desc: Hikmah Penciptaan Lalat - Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah Hikmah Penciptaan Lalat. Ramai dalam kalangan kita menghadapi masalah terutama masalah lalat. Apabila hendak makan lalat akan muncul dan dikhuatiri akan membawa penyakit. Bersama Ustaz Luqman yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Bersama Imam Muda Hassan
programme.desc: Bersama dengan Imam Muda Hassan memberikan ceramah berkaitan isu semasa berkaitan hal-hal agama.

programme.title: Jom Jalan S2 Ep13
programme.desc: Percutian di Pulau Tinggi - Bersama Jom Jalan kali ini Ariff Bahran akan membawa para penonton ke Pulau Tinggi. Jom Jalan musim kali ini membawa Selebriti tanah air ke pulau-pulau menarik yang ada di Malaysia. Pada setiap pelbagai destinasi menarik akan dipaparkan meliputi lokasi aktivi ketika percutian, makanan dan tempat-tempat menarik yang sesuai dikunjungi.

programme.title: Fail Harta Pusaka S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Nikah Sempadan - Episod kali ini membawa tajuk "Nikah Sempadan". Fail Harta Pusaka merupakan sebuah rancangan Doku Drama yang mengetengahkan seorang Pakar Perancangan Harta, Ketua Hakim, dan Panel Penasihat Syariah berpengalaman dalam pembahagian harta pusaka melalui HIBAH. Setiap episod akan mengupas isu-isu semasa yang dihadapi masyarakat, disampaikan dalam suasana santai dengan disertai lakonan semula.

programme.title: Religious Clip S109 Ep21
programme.desc: Kebaikanmu Tidak Dipersiakan oleh Allah - Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah Kebaikanmu Tidak Dipersiakan oleh Allah. Bersama Ustazah Syaurah yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Bacaan Al-quran V5&v6
programme.desc: Bacaan ayat suci Al Quran: 1. AL- BAQARAH (AYAT 177 - AYAT 182) 2. AL- IMRAN (AYAT 92 - AYAT 102) 3. AL-BAQARAH (AYAT 197 - AYAT 207) 4. AL- IMRAN (AYAT 133- AYAT 143) 5. AL- BAQARAH (AYAT 253- AYAT 257) 6. AL-IMRAN (AYAT 189 - AYAT 198)

programme.title: Cerita Bintang S2 Ep2
programme.desc: Khai Bahar - Cerita Bintang menampilkan artis-artis popular yang memberi peluang kepada peminat untuk lebih mengenali lebih rapat artis pujaan mereka. Episod kali ini Anis akan membawa penonton untuk menemu bual dengan Khai Bahar

programme.title: Game Over Romeo S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Firdaus semakin bimbang jika Kamal memang serius mahu membunuh dia lalu beritahu Black yang dia terpaksa juga hantar Tiya balik cepat kerana bimbang Tiya pula akan menjadi sasaran. Black cakap Firdaus kena percayakan dia walau apa pun yang dia buat. Firdaus akur.

programme.title: Bacaan Al-quran V2
programme.desc: Bacaan ayat suci Al Quran

programme.title: Menu Viral S1 Ep11
programme.desc: Jibril Platinum Walk - Episod kali ini bersama Cef Naem akan berada di Jibril Platinum Walk. Cef akan merasa menu yang viral tersebut sebelum berjumpa dengan tukang masak restoran untuk melihat sendiri resipi yang digunakan.

programme.title: Evolusi KL Drift 2
programme.desc: Aleeya mencemburui kehebatan Zack di litar lumba. Joe yang terlepas dari kemalangan maut masih lagi menaruh dendam ke atas Zack. Wajahnya yang berparut menguatkan lagi keazamannya untuk menghapuskan Zack dan orang-orangnya. Ery sebagai orang kanan Joe juga menaruh dendam pada Zack kerana kawan baiknya Karl dipenjarakan.

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V2
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Religious Clip S109 Ep19
programme.desc: Peranan Sedekah Menyembuh Penyakit - Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah Peranan Sedekah Menyembuh Penyakit. Bersama Dai Azrin yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Game Over Romeo S1 Ep7
programme.desc: Black datang ke rumah Firdaus membawa Azam yang berkerusi roda. Waktu ini Azam patut jalani terapi dan kakinya ada peluang untuk pulih. Cuma dia sedang down dan tak ada semangat atau malas hendak buat fisio. Azam nampak Hany dan tegur. Hany pelik sebab tidak mengenali Azam. Tiya hendak jelaskan tapi Azam menahan. Dia tidak mahu Tiya ceritakan tentang kisahnya pada Hany.

programme.title: Encik Ustaz
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang seorang jejaka yang bernama Faradi, terpaksa berbohong mengenai dirinya seorang bekas pelajar tahfiz dan bekerja di jabatan agama demi memikat seorang gadis yang bernama Atikah. Melaui pembohongan itu, Atikah menggelar Faradi sebagai ' Encik Ustaz'. Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada hubungan Faradi dan Atikah?

programme.title: Aku Cinta Sama Kamu Titik Tanpa Koma, No Kaleng Kaleng No Trauma
programme.desc: Dewi (Larasati Nugroho) gembira apabila baru sahaja menerima surat cerai dan kini rasmi menjadi janda, begitu juga dengan ayahnya. Namun, para isteri di kampungnya berasa tidak senang kerana menganggap Dewi mampu menggoda suami mereka. Kehadiran Sandy (Ridho Illahi), seorang doktor muda, turut menjadi buah mulut penduduk. programme.title: Cinta Di Ujung Sajadah S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Rindu dan Fauzan terpaksa berdepan dengan kenyataan pahit apabila penipuan masa lalu Rindu terbongkar. Fauzan yang marah mengusir Rindu keluar dari rumah, dan Rindu berjuang untuk mendapatkan hak penjagaan anak mereka, Ayu. Dalam penyesalan, Fauzan mula menyedari bahawa cintanya terhadap Rindu masih belum padam. Namun, segalanya menjadi rumit apabila Fauzan berkahwin dengan wanita lain bernama Alia. Di sisi lain, Rindu berkenalan dengan Hafiz yang benar-benar menyayanginya.

programme.title: D'Academy 6 S6 Ep9
programme.desc: D'Academy Musim 6 (DA6) merupakan acara pencarian bakat menyanyi dangdut untuk musim keenam D'Academy.

programme.title: Dewi Rindu S1 Ep220
programme.desc: Dewi adalah seorang gadis yang mempunyai impian yang sangat besar. Dia berazam untuk menjadi seorang yang berjaya dan membawa keluarganya keluar dari kesempitan hidup. Namun siapa sangka, impian indahnya itu musnah malah terpaksa mengharungi realiti pahit iaitu hamil di luar nikah.

programme.title: Saleha S1 Ep65
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Untungnya Jamu Masih Berputar Di Hatiku
programme.desc: Melati yang sedang menolak troli ubat herba tiba-tiba dilanggar oleh Ariko (El Ryan Carlen), menyebabkan dia terjatuh dan trolinya rosak. Mereka bertengkar apabila Melati menuntut ganti rugi, namun Ariko menolak. Tidak lama kemudian, penguat kuasa datang dan menahan mereka berdua kerana disyaki menjual ubat larangan.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta S1 Ep84
programme.desc: Starla dan Niko merupakan pasangan yang sempurna. Mereka mempunyai dua orang anak, iaitu Nila dan Daffa. Walaupun begitu, Niko secara rahsia menjalinkan hubungan dengan Ayu, rakan lama Starla dan Niko dari sekolah menengah. Mereka berdua cuba menyembunyikan hubungan tersebut dari siapa pun. Suatu hari, Ilham, suami Ayu, melihat mereka bermesraan di dalam kereta. Niko dan Ayu melarikan diri, Ilham mengejar mereka. Malangnya, mereka bertiga akhirnya terlibat dalam kemalangan.

programme.title: Tajwid Cinta S1 Ep120
programme.desc: Dafri baru saja kembali ke Indonesia untuk bertemu dengan Alina dan bertunang. Walau bagaimanapun, pertunangan itu terhalang kerana Nadia tidak suka dengan hubungan Dafri Bersama anak perempuannya, Alina. Nadia dengan sengaja menghantar Dafri untuk belajar di Turki agar Dafri jauh dari anak perempuannya. Selain itu, ayah Dafri meminta Dafri untuk berkahwin dengan Syifa, seorang wanita yang pertama kali Dafri temui. Pada ketika itu, Syifa gagal berkahwin kerana bakal suaminya, Ilham, tiba-tiba menghilangkan diri. Selepas berkahwin dengan Dafri, Syifa dan suaminya tinggal di Jakarta.

programme.title: My Heart S1 Ep92
programme.desc: Raisa yang patah hati selepas tunangnya, Rio, hilang tiba-tiba, pergi ke Jakarta untuk mencari jawapan. Di sana, dia bertemu Mike, seorang pelakon drama popular yang sebenarnya berperwatakan sensitif dan bermasalah, berbeza dengan wataknya di kaca TV. Perkenalan mereka secara kebetulan menjadi semakin rapat apabila mereka mula mengenali diri sebenar masing-masing. Namun, cinta mereka diuji apabila terbongkar bahawa ibu Mike, Rika, adalah isteri kedua kepada ayah Raisa, menyebabkan perebutan harta antara keluarga mereka.

Kehidupan Adam dan keluarganya pun berubah dengan drastik, namun Adam dan Sisil tetap menghadapi ujian ini dengan hati yang terbuka. Akhirnya, mereka berjaya bangkit semula dengan keberkatan yang diberikan oleh Allah.

Percutian mereka di Kuala Lumpur bertukar menjadi sebuah pengembaraan apabila terlibat sebagai saksi kes penculikan. Sekumpulan mafia menculik anak hartawan bernama Rahim. programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. programme.title: Janda Meletup
programme.desc: Rosnah, seorang janda muda cuba dipikat oleh Kamil yang tertarik dengannya namun gagal. Samad yang berasal dari Kuala Lumpur pergi ke kampung untuk mencari pembantu rumah dan bertemu Rosnah yang ingin bekerja dengannya. Kamil yang kecewa pergi ke Kuala Lumpur untuk berjumpa Rosnah selain tekadnya yang ingin bekerja dan mengahwini Rosnah. Suatu insiden terjadi menyebabkan Rosnah dan Kamil berganding bahu untuk menyelamatkan Samad.

Rostam, Roslan dan Rosdin mula jatuh cinta terhadap tiga anak dara yang cantik namun Salina, Sarina dan Satina menolak cinta mereka. Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the speed gang, led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the speed gang while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: The Comedy Of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fianc, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan

programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: 快乐生活一点通精编版
美丽四川优秀作品展播
Planet Shark S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Ultimate Predator - Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its prey's heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Ocean Voyagers - Navigate the ocean's vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1 Ep3
programme.desc: In the Extreme - Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys S1 Ep4
programme.desc: The Fires of Pele - The number one tourist attraction on the island of Hawaii is a volcano called Kilauea. After a sudden collapse of the crater floor, a massive eruption drains the volcano of lava and now Kilauea is silent. Geologist Phillip Ong finally has his chance to explore.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Vanishing Wilderness - Kenya's growing human population is taking land and resources away from wildlife. The squeeze is creating increasing numbers of conflicts between humans and animals, and is one of the biggest issues in African conservation.

programme.title: Extreme Africa S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Etosha: The Great White Place - Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser flamingos.

programme.title: Extreme Africa S1 Ep6
programme.desc: The Linear Oasis - Follow the course of South Africa's Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the beauty of Augrabies, this is the story of the Linear Oasis. We reveal how life is adapted to survive along its course and discover a rich world of plants and animals.

programme.title: Macro Worlds S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Winter is Coming - As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where it's warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring?

programme.title: Macro Worlds S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Meadow of Horror - It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it - you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror genre this extraordinary nature documentary takes you on a journey following a well-known hero with six legs, red wings and seven black dots through a seemingly normal meadow - but full of monsters.

programme.title: Macro Worlds S1 Ep3
programme.desc: God's Darling: Beetles - Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the world's animals are beetles. They have conquered almost every corner and every habitat on the planet and they have survived every global disaster. What is it that makes them so successful?

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S2 Ep6
programme.desc: Vancouver Island - Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canada's only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Fly Free - Observe vet Karina's fight to save a koala mauled by dogs, then face the clinic's toughest customer with vet Tim: a rainbow lorikeet who's quick to bite. Scoop up a peeved possum with rescuer Chantel and bond with Meaghan over a gaggle of goslings.

programme.title: Island Of The Monsoon S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Queen of Yala - The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It's time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

programme.title: Island Of The Monsoon S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Loka the Baby Elephant - Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mle of giants that make up his family.

programme.title: Island Of The Monsoon S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Lake Hunters - Sri Lanka's lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but don't be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

programme.title: Island Of The Monsoon S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Web of Life - A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet's biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa's east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Oceans - Dive to the darkest depths of the sea to uncover the ocean's most mysterious inhabitants. Journey across vast stretches of open water with humpback whales, then wander down to the ocean floor to witness breathtaking bioluminescence.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Coasts - Venture along Earth's coasts, where colliding worlds create a melting pot of biodiversity. Watch orcas hunt with precision, hold on as guillemot chicks take leaps of faith, crawl to safety with turtle hatchlings, and see crabs sculpt sandy galaxies.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Rivers - Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia's far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

programme.title: Beasts Of The Big Blue S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Snares Islands/ Tini Heke - Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

programme.title: Beasts Of The Big Blue S1 Ep2

programme.title: Beasts Of The Big Blue S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu - Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealand's South Island, where one of the world's longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet's biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa's east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters S1 Ep1

programme.title: Baby Animals S1 Ep1

programme.desc: Two brothers, living just 300 meters apart, lead vastly different lives. The elder, Kai-Teng Chiao, a former athlete turned plumber, gave up his dreams to support his family and finds unexpected healing through a connection with a distant, cold-hearted prosecutor. programme.title: Blessing of Formosa S1 Ep307
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: 6 Jilake
programme.desc: Sekumpulan samseng upahan yang dikenali sebagai 6 Jilake ditugaskan oleh syarikat penjajah untuk menguasai lombong bijih timah di negeri Perak pada abad ke-18. Namun mereka berhadapan dengan seorang pendekar kampung yang hebat dan sukar dikalahkan, lalu tercetus konflik besar penuh aksi dan jenaka.

programme.title: Duyung
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jimmy, seorang pemuda kampung yang mencintai alam sekitar dan hidup sederhana di tepi laut. Suatu hari, dia menyelamatkan seekor ikan duyung yang bertukar menjadi gadis jelita bernama Puteri. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidup Jimmy dan mencetuskan pelbagai kejadian lucu serta romantik antara manusia dan duyung.

programme.title: Reaksiar S1 Ep24
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Sejoli
programme.desc: Jo (Bront Palarae) dan Gina (Maya Karin) sedang menyembuhkan hati yang terluka di Phuket apabila takdir mempertemukan mereka. Pada mulanya mereka saling membenci, tetapi apabila mereka mendapat tahu bahawa bekas kekasih masing-masing, Hardy (Remy Ishak) dan Nita (Izara Aishah), akan berkahwin, mereka merancang untuk menggagalkan majlis perkahwinan tersebut.

programme.title: Cincin Pusaka
programme.desc: Alina dan Sofian adalah dua beradik yang saling cemburu, berlumba mengalahkan satu sama lain sejak kecil. Setelah kematian nenek, mereka berebut untuk memiliki cincin pusaka nenek yang kononnya mempunyai magis tertentu. Tetapi pelbagai halangan terjadi untuk mereka mewarisinya. Mampukah mereka menghadapi segala rintangan demi sebentuk cincin pusaka?

programme.title: Kid Detective, The (2020)
programme.desc: Kasut Ku Kusut mengisahkan seorang pemuda kampung bernama Manap yang berasa kecewa kerana kasut barunya telah hilang. Sementara itu, Markos, ahli kumpulan gangster Father Dragon, ditugaskan untuk membawa Suzi kepada ketua geng. Dalam perjalanan, mereka tersesat di sebuah kampung, dan Suzi berjaya melarikan diri lalu bertemu dengan Manap yang masih mencari kasutnya. Ketika Markos menemui mereka, Manap menyedari bahawa kasut yang dipakai oleh Markos kelihatan sangat mirip dengan kasutnya yang hilang.

programme.title: Hantu Tenggek
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penipu yang diketuai oleh Tariq yang berpura-pura mengusir tempat berhantu telah diperas ugut oleh Tuan Sidek, seorang pemaju bangunan. Mereka perlu meyakinkan pesaing Tuan Sidek bahawa bangunan tertentu berhantu apabila mereka terperangkap di dalamnya. Kecuali mereka tidak perlu meyakinkan kerana bangunan itu benar-benar dihantui oleh roh yang tidak tenteram. Roh memerlukan bantuan mereka untuk memenuhi hasrat terakhirnya

programme.title: Syawal Mencari Cinta
programme.desc: Pada pagi Raya, Syawal melepak bersama rakannya dan mereka tidak menunaikan solat sunat Hari Raya. Setelah selesai solat sunat Hari Raya, dia ternampak seorang gadis yang tidak pernah dilihatnya di kampung sebelum ini. Syawal terus berkesimpulan bahawa dia telah menemui cinta sejati. Dia telah mengunjung setiap rumah di kampung untuk menjejaki gadis tersebut. Selepas sekian lama mencari tanpa membuahkan hasil, Syawal terus mengumumkan kepada seluruh kampung bahawa dia akan melaksanakan rumah terbuka untuk hari raya dan semua orang dijemput hadir ke rumahnya. Namun demikian, setelah selesai rumah terbukanya, gadis yang dicari-cari Syawal masih tidak kelihatan. Dia kecewa lalu berputus asa. Tanpa sedar, gadis yang dijejaki selama ini adalah Cinta, sepupunya sendiri.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: Cinta Kura-kura
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Nani, seorang gadis ceria yang memiliki kura-kura peliharaan bernama Nico yang boleh bercakap. Hidup Nani berubah apabila dua lelaki Adam dan Fadzly mula cuba menambat hatinya, sementara Nico pula berusaha melindungi tuannya daripada lelaki yang disyakinya tidak ikhlas.

programme.title: Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: Charlie Hinton (lakonan Eddie Murphy) tiba-tiba hilang kerja. Disebabkan susah nak bayar yuran tadika anaknya, Charlie dan rakannya Phil cuba buka pusat jagaan kanak-kanak sendiri di rumah Daddy Day Care. Mula-mula memang kelam-kabut sebab dorang tak biasa jaga budak kecil, tapi lama-lama mereka belajar erti sabar, kasih sayang, dan tanggungjawab sebagai ayah. Dalam masa sama, mereka kena bersaing dengan tadika elit yang dikendalikan dengan tegas.

programme.title: Gerabak Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luna, usahawan berjaya yang ditipu tunangnya, Razi. Dia kecewa apabila perniagaan yang mereka usahakan rugi kerana Razi terbabit dengan skandal wang serta mempunyai perempuan simpanan. Sementara itu, Gie pula baru saja dibuang kerja. Walaupun masih mencari kerja, dia sangat tenang dan tetap ceria. Gie reda dengan situasi menimpanya.

programme.title: Jodoh Tak Salah Alamat
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luqman pernah mengenali seorang gadis bernama Diana ketika Diana melanggar keretanya dahulu. Diana berpenampilan seksi dan mengamalkan cara hidup barat membuatkan Luqman bersangka buruk terhadap Diana. Satu hari, Luqman ke masjid dan terserempak dengan seorang gadis cantik iaitu Adawiyah. Tanpa mengetahui, Adawiyah dan Diana adalah orang yang sama. Diana pernah terlibat dengan kemalangan dan sejak itu hidupnya berubah sepenuhnya.

programme.title: Ruang Temu S1 Ep68
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Elevator Game
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sekumpulan remaja yang mencuba permainan ritual misteri dikenali sebagai Elevator Game, di mana pemain perlu menekan butang lif dengan urutan tertentu untuk membuka dimensi lain. Namun, permainan ini membawa mereka ke dunia gelap penuh ancaman.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP3 S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Memaparkan Rafeeq bertekad mahu menghapuskan Afifah, supaya dia bebas dari cengkaman Zacky. Zacky berkawan baik dengan Rizq, abang tiri kepada Afifah. Bapa Afifah minta tolong Zacky dan Rizq membantunya memulih Afifah yang kini lupa ingatan dan mengalami truama. Adelia masih marahkan Afifah yang menyebabkan abangnya Zacky mengalami tekanan selepas dia memutuskan hubungan dengan Zacky. Adelia kemudiannya ke rumah abangnya, malangnya dia telah dibunuh. Zacky kembali berbaik dengan Afifah setelah gadis tersebut meminta maaf. Tanpa mengetahui sebenar Zacky ialah pembunun misteri tersebut.

programme.title: The Sacret Of Sinchanee
programme.desc: Seorang pemandu trak tunda industri yang mengalami insomnia kembali ke rumah zaman kanak-kanaknya selepas kematian bapanya, untuk mengetahui bahawa kehadiran paranormal telah tinggal di rumah itu dan menghantui tanah suci yang dibina di atasnya.

programme.title: The Invoking 2
programme.desc: Walaupun beratus-ratus peristiwa paranormal yang mengganggu berlaku setiap tahun, kebanyakan pertemuan mengerikan ini tidak dilaporkan - sehingga kini. Bersaksilah ketika mangsa malang mengalami ketakutan yang tidak terkata apabila berhadapan dengan kuasa syaitan, poltergeist pembunuh dan entiti jahat lain yang mati bersedia untuk menuntut jiwa mereka . Turun ke jurang mimpi buruk yang terjaga ketika roh-roh jahat yang dahagakan darah ini berusaha untuk memiliki mangsa mereka dan menyeret mereka-menendang dan menjerit-turun ke neraka.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP2 S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aafiyah kecewa apabila abangnya tidak melayan panggilannya, tambahan pula dia ketakutan dan dalam keadaan trauma. Aafiyah mengalami trauma, dia terpaksa melarikan diri apabila dikejar lelaki misteri dan cuba membunuhnya. Nasib baik Abang Zack muncul dan menyelamatkannya. Aafiyah balik ke rumah setelah sihat. Aafiyah sukakan Zack tetapi bukan sebagi kekasih. Aafiyah sekali lagi menjadi trauma apabila kucing kesayangannya di bunuh. Ini semua angkara Zacky yang menggunakan Rafeeq bagi memuaskan hatinya.

programme.title: Longlegs
programme.desc: Ejen FBI Lee Harker menyiasat rangkaian pembunuhan keluarga yang dikaitkan dengan pembunuh misteri Longlegs. Ketika menjejaki jejak okultisme dan kod rahsia, Lee mendapati kaitan peribadi yang mengancam nyawanya dan semua yang dia sayangi.

programme.title: Sebelum Titik Noktah EP1 S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Hariz, seorang novelis terkenal mendapati kekasihnya curang. Andy sahabat baiknya, selamatkan Hariz dengan membawanya ke pekan yang kecil sehingga Amelia muncul di perkampungan tersebut kerana tunangnya dijumpai lemas.

programme.title: Sebelum Titik Noktah EP2 S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Amelia simpan rahsia bahawa dia bertengkar dengan Amer di dalam hutan dan dia yang tolak Amer jatuh, dia fikir dia yang sebabkan kematian tunangnya itu. Namun bila Amelia dapat tahu tentang ada kesan 'seolah diikat' leher Amer. Dia pula mengesyaki Hariz, kerana Amelia yakin ada orang lain di hutan itu.

programme.title: Sebelum Titik Noktah EP3 S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Hariz mulai punyai suspek baru iaitu Budi yang sebelum ini hanya baik dan dilihat sebagai peminat setianya. Namun Hariz dapat tahu di rumah Budi ada seorang lelaki tua diikat kaki tangannya. Siapa lelaki ini?

programme.title: Sebelum Titik Noktah EP4 S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Hariz yakin Budi ada kena mengena kerana Budi ada masa dia bertengkar dengan Andy, Hariz tahu Budi adalah peminatnya, mungkin peminat ini bunuh mereka yang cuba sakiti Hariz.

programme.title: Kutuk
programme.desc: Maya, seorang jururawat yang baru berpindah ke sebuah asrama lama di pinggir bandar, mula diganggu oleh kejadian aneh dan menyeramkan. Dia kemudian menyedari bahawa asrama itu menyimpan rahsia gelap tentang sumpahan yang menghantui setiap penghuni yang tinggal di situ. Untuk menyelamatkan diri, Maya perlu membongkar misteri di sebalik kutukan tersebut sebelum terlambat.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Seorang psikolog kanak-kanak yang menjadi janda menjalani kehidupan terpencil di kawasan luar bandar New England. Terkandas dalam ribut salji yang mematikan, dia mesti mencari cara untuk menyelamatkan seorang budak lelaki sebelum dia hilang selamanya.

programme.title: Bisikan Syaitan
programme.desc: Pasangan Kamil dan Soraya mengikat perjanjian berdarah dengan kuasa jahat demi kemewahan, tetapi apabila Soraya ditangkap atas kes pembunuhan, rahsia mereka mula terbongkar dan gangguan ghaib menimpa keluarga.

programme.title: Taxi 3
programme.desc: Sekumpulan pencuri yang menggelarkan diri mereka sebagai Geng Santa Claus sedang menimbulkan kekacauan, dan polis tidak dapat mengejarnya. Kapten polis Gilbert terganggu oleh seorang wartawan Cina yang menulis cerita tentang skuadnya, isteri detektif Emilien baru sahaja mengumumkan bahawa dia hamil, dan pemandu teksi Daniel sedang mengalami krisis hubungan. Selepas rentetan kesilapan di mana pencuri mengakali polis berkali-kali dengan wartawan di sana untuk merakam semuanya, Daniel dan teksi supernya masuk.

programme.title: Petaka
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kemiskinan hidup keluarga Sham selepas kematian ayahnya. Ibunya menderita sakit kaki, manakala adiknya, Syikin tidak mampu ke sekolah kerana kekangan kewangan. Kedaifan keluarganya berubah secara drastik apabila Sham menerima tawaran bekerja sebagai pemandu lori barang di kedai perabot Haziq. Tugasnya hanya mengambil dan menghantar barangan perabot dari sempadan Thailand ke kedai Haziq di Alor Setar. Haziq bekerja di bawah Datuk Jamil.

programme.title: The Sacred Riana: Beginning
programme.desc: Selepas memutuskan untuk tinggal sementara di vila kampung halaman mereka sambil menantikan kelahiran bayi pertama, pasangan Junui dan Biroo menghadapi gangguan yang bukan sahaja melibatkan kenangan silam tetapi juga kehadiran misteri di rumah yang mereka duduki. Junui mula terganggu oleh bayangan cinta lamanya, Jihhee, yang hilang di vila itu, manakala Biroo melihat jejak-jejak asing dan merasa seperti sentiasa diawasi.

programme.title: Janin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aisya yang baru kehilangan anak akibat keguguran dan mula diganggu oleh bayangan serta suara misteri yang memanggilnya ibu. Suaminya, Farid, cuba membantu namun keadaan menjadi semakin buruk apabila rahsia lama yang disembunyikan mula terbongkar bahawa roh janin itu menuntut keadilan atas dosa masa lalu mereka.

programme.title: Motif
programme.desc: Sementara itu, penyiasat Sara dibunuh oleh Madam Kwan yang menyembunyikan rahsia gelap suaminya. Namun Hamdi berjaya melarikan diri dan mendedahkan lokasi sebenar Kasyorga. Rodi, walau cedera, kembali bangkit untuk menyelamatkan Kasyorga. Akhirnya, Vince-anak Madam Kwanmuncul, menandakan konspirasi belum berakhir.

programme.title: Black S1 EP6 S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Di Seri Setia, Black dan Sofia bekerjasama untuk menghalang satu pembunuhan yang berpotensi untuk berlaku. Semasa berada di sana, Black terimbas kembali masa lalu Malik, satu fenomena yang membingungkannya. Pemergian mereka ini juga merupakan titik perubahan cara Sofia melihat keupayaannya. Kesanggupan Sofia menggadaikan nyawanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa orang lain memperbaharui tanggapan Black terhadapnya. Adakah cinta mula berputik? Black tertarik dan pada masa yang sama bingung dengan perasaannya terhadap Sofia, satu perasaan yang asing buat Black, seorang yang mementingkan diri. Tetapi hari yang bersinar menjadi pudar apabila Black kembali ke rumah dan mendapati bilik tersembunyi Malik telah digeledah dan dikosongkan. Sementara itu, pembunuh upahan telah meragut nyawa seorang lagi mangsa dan Detektif Borhan mendapati kematian itu ada kaitan dengan pembunuhan Nurul Najwa.
